header.desc: Paste the raw transcript or upload it as a TXT file. The system removes unnecessary talk and turns it into lecture notes.

input.title: Raw Transcript
input.hint: Paste or upload a TXT file
input.overLimit: The text exceeds the 40,000-character limit (excess: {over}). Please shorten it.
input.longWarning: Long transcript — processing may take a few minutes. Do not close the page.

about.title: What is this module?
about.item1: The raw transcript is cleaned and converted into lecture-note format
about.item2: The instructor’s content is left untouched — only unnecessary talk is removed
about.item3: Human Design channel and gate numbers are corrected automatically
about.item4: Question-and-answer sections are preserved and formatted

result.title: Cleaned Lecture Notes
result.emptyTitle: The cleaned notes will appear here
result.processingHint: The AI is processing the transcript. This may take a few minutes.
result.emptyHint: Paste the transcript into the left panel and click the clean button.

info.keptDesc: What the instructor says is not changed; unnecessary talk is removed.
info.hdDesc: Channel and gate numbers are written correctly automatically.
info.exportDesc: Download the cleaned notes as Word or TXT.

toast.wordFailed: The Word file could not be created.
toast.doneMsg: The lecture notes were cleaned successfully.

apiErrors.TEXT_TOO_LONG: The text is too long. Maximum 40,000 characters.
apiErrors.EMPTY_OUTPUT: Processing finished, but the output was empty. Please try again.
apiErrors.OUTPUT_CHECK_FAILED: The output did not pass the safety check. Please try a shorter piece of text.
apiErrors.CHUNK_FAILED: A part of the text could not be processed. Please try again.
apiErrors.PROCESSING_FAILED: Processing could not be completed right now. Please try again or contact support.
